changelog: Aura AI v2.3.5 — Separate Deepgram & Gemini API Keys
Deepgram now has its own dedicated API key field — switching engines no longer overwrites keys
Pre-configured Deepgram key works immediately without manual entry
Removed deprecated gemini-1.5-flash model from Gemini Speech fallback chain
Gemini Speech now tries gemini-3.8-flash then gemini-2.5-flash only
